failure_summary.description: Agents chose an associated or overly specific answer despite the clue's exact requested relation or shared completion.
Agents gave a synonymous or expanded name rather than the expected concise conventional label.
A bare title-and-year clue was treated as the answer instead of using context to infer the requested fact.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already covered by the skill's guidance on exact relations, answer scope, and shared completions, but the agents did not follow it. The bare-title case is isolated, and a similar general rule was rejected in a previous step; adding overlapping guidance is not warranted.
